# CRM Customer Profiles & Buying Logic

| Customer profile | Buying trigger | Evaluation evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Export manufacturer | Large overseas account pool, RFQ volume, long sales cycles and fragmented ERP/CRM data | Time to first response, quotation time, follow-up coverage, quote accuracy and forecast variance |
| Industrial distributor | Complex price rules, channel ownership and repeat quotation work | Price-version control, approval time, order linkage and receivables visibility |
| Cross-border B2B team | Multiple regions, languages, time zones and outreach channels | Source traceability, consent controls, multilingual workflow and activity completeness |
| B2B software or services firm | Pipeline visibility, stakeholder coordination and renewal forecasting | CRM adoption, forecast quality, proposal cycle and renewal handoff |
| International logistics provider | Lane-based quotations, service handoffs and contract follow-up | Quote turnaround, opportunity ageing, lane/rate integration and collection status |
